Izumi Seinikuten / Kagoshima food

Kagoshima food

Kagoshima specialties between rounds of yakiniku, available from the Satsuma course (¥3,980).

From Kagoshima Specials 3,980

Kagoshima Kurobuta pork steak

Kagoshima's black Berkshire pork is known for its fine texture and sweet fat. Cut thick and grilled as a steak.

From Kagoshima Specials 3,980

Kurobuta pork tongue

Tongue of Kurobuta pork, with a pleasant bite. Best with the salt sauce.

From Kagoshima Specials 3,980

Chicken sashimi

Thinly sliced raw chicken, a long-standing Kagoshima dish. This dish is served raw; please choose it only if you are comfortable eating raw chicken. One plate per person.

From Kagoshima Specials 3,980

Satsuma-age fish cake

Fried fish cake made from minced fish, a Kagoshima specialty.

From Wagyu Steak 4,480

Two Kagoshima wagyu steaks

A tasting of two cuts of Japanese Black wagyu raised in Kagoshima.

Questions & answers

Can we try Kagoshima specialties?

From the Satsuma course (¥3,980) you can order Kagoshima Kurobuta pork steak, Kurobuta tongue, chicken sashimi and satsuma-age fish cake. Chicken sashimi is raw chicken, limited to one plate per person.

Is the chicken sashimi raw?

Yes, it is raw chicken. If you are not comfortable eating raw chicken, please choose another dish. One plate per person.

Do you have vegetarian dishes?

We are a meat-focused restaurant and do not offer a dedicated vegetarian menu.

Reserve by phone. Same-day tables can be checked, too.

Phone lines open at 16:00. Courses are for two or more guests; table-only reservations are accepted from one guest.
